title: FIFTH AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 12-3049 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LONG BEACH HARBOR DEPARTMENT TO HOST AND MAINTAIN THE PORTS DRAYAGE TRUCK REGISTRY
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - FIFTH AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 12-3049 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LONG BEACH HARBOR DEPARTMENT TO HOST AND MAINTAIN THE PORTS DRAYAGE TRUCK REGISTRY
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the proposed Fifth Amendment to Agreement No. 12-3049 (Agreement) between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and the City of Long Beach Harbor Department (POLB) to host and maintain the Ports Drayage Truck Registry (PDTR). The proposed Fifth Amendment will extend the term of the Agreement by five years to December 31, 2031, and increase the total Agreement authority amount by $256,093 from $246,190 currently to $502,283 as proposed. The Harbor Department will continue to be financially responsible for its share of expenses incurred under this Agreement. This Agreement is in alignment with Strategic Objective 2: An Efficient, Secure, and Sustainable Supply Chain.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the proposed Fifth Amendment to Agreement No. 12-3049 between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department and the City of Long Beach Harbor Department to extend the term by five years and increase compensation by $256,093 for a not to exceed amount of $502,283; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and Board Secretary to attest to said amendment for and behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No.__________.
Environmental Management
